E. The balance of environmental impacts between the proposed action and alternatives:
The balance appears obviously to be in favor of the proposed action. The original intent of the project was to eliminate blight and blighting conditions and provide decent, safe, and sanitary housing. The Randolph community has met all the criteria, followed all the guidelines, and done all that is in their power to accomplish their goals for a "new Randolph". The preponderance of adverse environmental impact now exists in the Randolph Community and can only be eliminated by implementation of the proposed project.
